source: NASA Moon Trek, LRO LOLA DEM 5mpp, Site04: Shackleton Rim, S Pole (Site04_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif)
credit: Barker, M.K., et al. (2020), Improved LOLA Elevation Maps for South Pole Landing Sites: Error Estimates and Their Impact on Illumination Conditions, Planetary & Space Science, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
elevation_reference: metres relative to a 1737400 m radius
processing: local window centred on source pixel (200,1024), about 1.0 km east and 5.1 km south of the tile corner, chosen as the flattest 1.28 km window; regional window centred on (700,1000), 10x10 block mean; gaps filled with nearest value. About 90 percent of source pixels are interpolated by the original authors.
label: NASA DATA (derived)
